svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hub-and-spoke network on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Hub-and-spoke network on Google Cloud. 9 components in 11 groups. Connections: Corporate servers to Edge router; Edge router to Cloud Interconnect (Dedicated Interconnect); Edge router to Cloud VPN (IPsec tunnels); Edge router to Cloud Router (BGP sessions); Cloud Interconnect to Network Connectivity Center (hybrid spoke); Cloud VPN to Network Connectivity Center (hybrid spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Production VPC (VPC spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Shared services VPC (VPC spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Development VPC (VPC spoke).

text.tspan: On-premises reaches three spoke VPCs through Network Connectivity Center, over Cloud Interconnect with an HA VPN backup
